week_classification.description: build, absorb, load, recovery, sharpening, taper, race_week, transition holiday or re_entry (holiday = at least 4 days of an Intervals HOLIDAY event in the planned week).

friel_cycle_type.description: maintenance = holiday week: light, low structure, does not reset the block.

macro_phase.description: transition = easy, unstructured days after a completed A/B race.

threshold_tests.description: Friel rest & test decision. Test in a recovery week (or block week 1 right after one) only a discipline that is due and relevant to the A-race; never in a return-from-break week.

block_rhythm.description: 3:1 by default; 2:1 after illness, a break, overreaching markers or a daily-signal alert.

season_checkpoints.description: B/C races from the Intervals calendar as checkpoints toward the A-race.

return_from_break.description: True when training_load.return_from_break.status is returning: a re-entry week, not week N of the old block.
